timedMC.title: Beat the clock

questions.text: Look! The children        in the garden.
wrongReasons: Subject-verb agreement: "the children" is plural, so the auxiliary is "are", not "is".
Wrong tense: "Look!" signals something happening now — that needs the present continuous, not the present simple.
Missing -ing: after "are", use the -ing form — "playing", not "play".
